children: TransUnion announced that Todd M. Cello will resign as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer effective December 31, 2026, and will provide transition services through March 1, 2027.
Executive Vice President, Chief Financial Officer
Resignation effective Dec 31, 2026; transition services through Mar 1, 2027; benefits through Mar 31, 2027
Not related to a disagreement with the Company on operations, policies or practices
Company will conduct comprehensive search; board to appoint interim CFO if no successor by Transition Date
Performance share units issued Feb 28, 2024 will continue to vest through Feb 28, 2027 if employed through that date

title: Todd M. Cello to Resign as TransUnion CFO, Transition Through March 1, 2027
